brief.headline: Database Guardian could not produce a grounded proposal
brief.what_broke: 12 session(s) waiting on locks. Root blocker(s): pid 122027 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_inventory, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) blocks 1 session(s); last statement: SELECT 1
brief.who_is_affected: Checkout success 77% over 10s (7/31 failed) vs SLO 95%. Revenue run-rate $18,400/min; about $4,155/min at risk. Verification window 10s. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout.

options.description: Terminate the root blocker session (batch_worker/batch_replayable_inventory, pid 122027) to release its locks.
Take no action; let the blocker finish and monitor checkout recovery.
options.cost: about $4,155/min of checkout revenue at risk while waiting

audit.report: A replayable batch inventory job blocked checkout, causing 4 timeouts since injection and 0% initial success. The Database Guardian could not produce a grounded proposal after two failed grounding checks, so the incident was escalated to on-call without executing any recovery action. Over the last 15 seconds, checkout succeeded 33 of 60 times (55%) with 27 timeouts. In a 10-second verification window, success was 77% against a 95% SLO, putting about $4,155 per minute of the $18,400 per minute revenue run-rate at risk. The business tolerates at most 60 seconds of degraded checkout, and no action was executed within the 12.6-second negotiation.
audit.root_cause: pid 122027 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_inventory, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) held locks that blocked checkout sessions.
lessons: For batch_replayable_inventory, alert and auto-terminate any transaction idle longer than 30 seconds to prevent lock buildup during checkout peaks.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian wasted the single round by failing grounding twice and producing no executable action, missing the lock and revenue evidence needed to justify a kill.
follow_ups: Terminate pid 122027 and verify checkout returns above 95% success within the 60-second tolerance window.
Add a pre-negotiation evidence checklist requiring blocker PID, transaction age, blocked session count, and revenue at risk for the batch_replayable_inventory workload.

events.title: Incident injected: Replayable batch blocks checkout

data.story: The nightly inventory reconcile job holds a row lock on the hottest SKU. Checkout times out. The job is idempotent and resumes from a checkpoint.
